integration_conditions.app_activation: Separate integration release required; this library alone changes no app consumer.
integration_conditions.scope: Pure normal local/distortional section operators only, per eligible signed branch.
integration_conditions.My_positive: Inherited bounded EN13 Eq5.10b interpretation for mixed flanges with wholly compressed physical As; no additional universal translating-junction eigenmode requirement or qualification.
integration_conditions.curling_shear_lag: Applicability must be qualified for the actual profile and moment diagram; the seven legacy Ue100 proofs are not transferred.
integration_conditions.EN6_1_6: Use the same coherent gross contour for B and shear/torsional terms; this normal library does not qualify the combined check.
integration_conditions.EN6_27: Requires separately qualified EN shear capacities and concurrent signed action fields; no NBR/AISI substitution.
integration_conditions.centroid_transport: Apply axial transport once and do not credit favourable centroid shifts determined at fy.
